summary: MINISO Group filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes revenue of RMB 11,498.9 million for 26H1, up 22.4% year-over-year, with store count reaching 8,674. The announcement covers operational metrics, segment performance, and capital returns, but no M&A, tender offer, strategic review, or other special-situation event is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a standard quarterly results announcement.
